rows.en: ...You're sure about this, Koji?
rows.notes: Yumi confirms Koji's resolve to return Mazinger Z to battle.

rows.en: Yes. Mazinger Z has fought Dr. Hell's army and Mycenae, and defeated them both...
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Yes... Now it rests in the Robot Museum alongside Tetsuya's Great Mazinger, as a symbol of peace.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: But with new enemies appearing one after another, Mazinger Z will go into battle again.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: And I'm sure my grandfather and my father would want that too.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Koji, I'm glad you've made up your mind. I'll contact the museum myself, then.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Thank you. Please do. ...So, how is Tetsuya?
rows.notes: Koji asks Yumi to contact the museum, then asks after Tetsuya.

rows.en: I hear his wounds from the battle with the Mycenae Empire have healed, and he's started rehabilitation.
rows.notes: He refers to Tetsuya, settled by the preceding question and sourced male profile.

rows.en: Knowing him, it's probably more like intensive training than rehabilitation.
rows.notes: Thought about Tetsuya; intensive training contrasts with rehabilitation.

rows.en: He'll probably join the Nahel Argama team with Jun before long.
rows.notes: He remains Tetsuya; Jun accompanies him. Team refers to the Nahel Argama force.

rows.en: Understood. Then please give my regards to Sayaka, Boss and the others too.
rows.notes: Koji requests that Yumi pass on his regards; direction retained.

rows.en: Ah, about that... I plan to have them join you very soon too.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Then things will get lively again.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Well, Koji... I wish you all success in battle.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: You're going to pick up Mazinger Z?
rows.notes: Kaine addresses Koji, restoring the omitted you.

rows.en: Yeah. Fighting in the TFO is getting pretty tough, too.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: It's... in a museum now, right?
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: That's right, along with Great. I hear the place is packed with kids on holidays.
rows.notes: Great remains the source nickname for Great Mazinger.

rows.en: Those two are especially popular, even at the Robot Museum.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: I've been wondering for a while. Why is Mazinger Z in a place like that?
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Yeah, exactly. If you kept it at a base like Raideen, you could use it anytime.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Some people in the military don't like having super robots at civilian facilities...
rows.notes: Super robots follows campaign_terms contextual convention; civilian custody is the issue.

rows.en: Putting them in the museum is a way of dealing with those people.
rows.notes: Museum arrangement appeases military objectors from row21.

rows.en: Huh... There's a lot going on behind the scenes, isn't there?
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: But they're kept in perfect shape so we can use them in an emergency.
rows.notes: Plural they refers to the two museum robots, not the pilots.

rows.en: That sounds risky. What'll you do if the enemy steals them?
rows.notes: Plural them refers to the two museum robots; Tapp warns of enemy seizure.

rows.en: That's part of why I'm planning to go pick it up right now, but...
rows.notes: It refers to Mazinger Z, which Koji is going to retrieve. Deliberate trailing but retained.

rows.en: ...Are you really sure about this, Koji?
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: What do you mean?
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: The TFO was the very embodiment of your passion for space. And yet...
rows.notes: Daisuke worries Koji will abandon his space ambitions; deliberate unfinished transition retained.

rows.en: What are you talking about, Daisuke? I'm not planning to throw the TFO away.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.
Source nonverbal exclamation retained.

rows.en: I'm just putting my dream of space exploration on hold.
rows.notes: Space exploration dream is postponed, not abandoned; original neighboring Daisuke ! is all-source31.

rows.en: Besides, once this war is over, I plan to overhaul the TFO so it can fly to the ends of the universe.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Huh, so... that's the kind of dream you've got?
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Is that so strange?
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: No, no... A man's got to dream that big.
rows.notes: Source explicitly invokes manhood; masculine boast retained.

rows.en: Heh heh, right?
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: You two talk a good game, considering you tried to peep into the bath together.
rows.notes: Tapp needles both Koji and Kaine about their bath-peeping attempt; no softening.

rows.en: Hey, how'd you find out about that?
rows.notes: Kaine reacts to Tapp knowing about the bath-peeping attempt. Draft added hell without explicit source support; removed during meaning audit, not for fit.

rows.en: Roux told me.
rows.notes: Roux spelling follows glossary.

rows.en: Th-that girl! She really did suspect us, didn't she!?
rows.notes: She refers to Roux, explicitly sourced female in glossary. Stutter and accusation retained.

rows.en: ...Well then, Koji...
rows.notes: Daisuke deliberately trails off addressing Koji; unfinished connective retained.

rows.en: Yeah. I'll restore peace with Mazinger Z's power... My dream comes after that.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: When that day comes, I'm counting on your help too, Daisuke, okay?
rows.notes: Koji requests Daisuke's future assistance, rather than offering his own.

rows.en: Of course I'll help.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Well then, Koji... Please be extra careful.
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Don't you go wandering off on the way, okay?
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: I know, I know! All right, I'm off!
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. TFO shot down
rows.notes: Plain defeat condition, paired with all-source192 enemy-annihilation victory condition.

rows.en: ...Ten more minutes to the Robot Museum. It's a bit of a detour, but I can't let the enemy spot me.
rows.notes: Koji alone takes a detour to avoid detection on his way to Robot Museum.

rows.en: Still, they probably don't think the real Mazinger and Great are on display in a museum...
rows.notes: Mazinger and Great retain source shorthand; trailing speculation retained.
Source nonverbal startled punctuation retained.

rows.en: Tch! The Vegan Empire!!
rows.notes: Context follows the adjacent speakers in numeric use order; subject and action retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... A lone fly buzzing around a place like this, is it?
rows.notes: Barendos contemptuously calls Koji a lone fly; taunt retained.

rows.en: Perfect... I'll capture him and make him tell me what he knows about Grendizer.
rows.notes: Him is Koji, the target identified in this event; capture/interrogation intent retained.

rows.en: If I run away now, they might find out about the Robot Museum...!
rows.notes: Thought: fleeing could reveal the museum; next original row201 confirms he must fight through.

rows.en: I'll just have to find some way through this!
rows.notes: Internal resolve after considering risk of exposing the Robot Museum.

rows.en: Grr! How dare you do this to me!! But I have Great's data now! Fwahahaha!!
rows.notes: Great is the source-short form of Great Mazinger; defeat-event boast.

rows.en: Quit being such a sore loser!
Forgive me, Koji! This is the only way I can get Barendos to let his guard down!
rows.notes: Duke apologizes to Koji; he is deliberately provoking Barendos into lowering his guard.
Listener: Daisuke/scene-specific listeners on repeats. Koji silence; retained in all uses, including later scene repeats.

rows.en: Feel the power of Great Mazinger for yourself!
If only I can land a hit on its back!
rows.notes: Its back means Great Mazinger; later original354-360 settle the wing-storage vulnerability. Conditional wish remains open.

rows.en: I'll defeat you without even using Great Mazinger!
Grendizer and I won't lose to a coward like you!
I'll pay you back double for everything you've done to me!!
Keep blabbing! I'll strike you down instead!
rows.notes: Meaning correction: makes the counterattack defeat explicit.

rows.en: Barendos! How dare you use such dirty tricks!
Damn... If things had gone as planned, I could have defeated Duke Fleed and Koji Kabuto in one fell swoop...!
Heh... It looks like Planet Vega's Royal Guard Captain isn't much good at fighting for himself.
rows.notes: Sarcastic Royal Guard Captain title; Planet Vega preserved as explicit source place.

rows.en: Yeah. If he's trying to make us fight each other, he must have next to no confidence in his own strength.
rows.notes: Us/each other refers to allies being manipulated into friendly fire, not fighting among Vegan troops.

rows.en: You bastards... You've said enough!
Then come on, Barendos! Face me head-on, and someone like you is nothing to fear!
Too bad, old man! There's no way Mazinger Z is losing to a crook like you!
Neither will Great Mazinger or Grendizer!
rows.notes: Answers Ginga: neither robot will lose. Restored predicate makes the source elliptical addition grammatical.

rows.en: You little brats! I'll force those smart mouths of yours shut!
We won't let you! We can't let a coward like you get away with this either!
He's using mind control on Koji to make us fight each other! What a filthy opponent...!
rows.notes: Us/each other restores the allied friendly-fire participants. Meaning correction: restores Barendos as the subject of the mind-control action.

rows.en: Say what you like! Victory is everything in battle!
Not a chance! We can't let you have that victory!
For someone with your title, you sure seem to excel at sneaky little tricks!
rows.notes: Female lead mocks Barendos; runtime speaker placeholder preserved.

rows.en: You little girl! You dare mock me, the Captain of King Vega's Royal Guard!?
rows.notes: Title explicitly names King Vega; not GEAR commander Vega.

rows.en: That's right! Tell him some more, #女愛称!
rows.notes: Male lead asks female lead to keep insulting Barendos; exact runtime placeholder retained.

rows.en: If you've got such a grand title, then show us a way of fighting worthy of it! You coward!
rows.notes: Female lead demands combat conduct worthy of title.

rows.en: Damn you... Damn yooou!!
Whatever tricks you use, we have no intention of losing!
Heh! Don't think you can take the great Koji Kabuto down that easily!
rows.notes: Great is boastful self-address, not a robot name here.

rows.en: Hmph. Enjoy your cockiness while it lasts.
Deploy Saucer Beast Jinjin. Capture him.
rows.notes: Barendos orders subordinate to deploy Jinjin and capture Koji.

rows.en: Damn it, they've sent out a Saucer Beast!
Y-you bastard!! What the hell are you doing!? Let go! Let go of me!!
rows.notes: Koji addresses Jinjin; struggle/shouts preserved.

rows.en: Hehehehe...
Ugh... Uuugh... Where am I...?
Th-that's right... They captured me... Then am I inside Motherburn...?
That's right.
Y-you're...!?
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished recognition/question.

rows.en: I am Barendos... Captain of the Vegan Empire's Royal Guard...
rows.notes: Royal Guard Captain identity and Vegan Empire affiliation both preserved.

rows.en: Koji Kabuto, you can no longer escape. Give up and do as I say.
Don't screw with me! I'd never listen to the likes of you!
rows.notes: Restores refusal to obey from preceding demand.

rows.en: Then you leave me no choice. ...Do it.
rows.notes: Order to subordinate to activate coercion.

rows.en: Yes, sir!
rows.notes: Empty prefilled speaker resolved through campaign_terms speaker alias as Vegan Soldier.

rows.en: Uwaaaaah!!
Hehehe... Even if you won't talk, I only need to use that mind-control device.
rows.notes: Mind-control device is fictional coercion instrument, not an added mechanism.

rows.en: What's this cheap trick you're pulling!? The great Koji won't fall for a trick like this!!
rows.notes: Great Koji preserves boastful self-reference.

rows.en: Hmph, you fool. Don't you realize you've already fallen for it?
Ugaaah!!
Koji Kabuto, however much you resist now, it's no use.
U-uuugh...
Now, you're going to tell me about yourself and your comrades.
rows.notes: Plural you restored as Koji and comrades, matching request for group information.

rows.en: Ugh...
When and where did you first take part in battle?
I-I... Two years ago, I was attacked by Baron Ashura's Mechanical Beasts...
rows.notes: Stammer and trailing recollection preserved; sentence continues into111.

rows.en: I climbed into Mazinger Z... the invincible robot my grandpa built...
rows.notes: First-person action restored; invincible robot and grandfather attribution retained.

rows.en: An invincible robot?
rows.notes: Barendos repeats the claim in source111, under forced interrogation.

rows.en: Yes... Whoever possesses Mazinger Z... can become a god or a devil...
rows.notes: Koji recites the god/devil maxim under mental coercion; pauses retained.

rows.en: Oh, really... And then?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: I fought Dr. Hell in Mazinger Z, and defeated him...
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: What happened after that?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Then I... went to America to study flying saucers...
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Meanwhile, Tetsuya... fought the Mycenae Empire in Great Mazinger... and drove them from the surface...
rows.notes: Tetsuya is the actor; surface means the surface world rather than extermination.

rows.en: I see... And what became of Mazinger Z and Great Mazinger?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Those two... were put in the Robot Museum... as symbols of peace...
rows.notes: Interrogation answer trails off; restored passive verb for the settled museum placement.

rows.en: Then you met Duke Fleed and joined forces with him... Now, what fighting strength do you have?
rows.notes: Barendos asks about the allied combat strength, not simply the strength of an individual robot.

rows.en: U-uuugh... Guh...!
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Captain, using the device any longer would be dangerous!
rows.notes: Filled blank speaker from campaign_terms speaker_aliases: Vegan Soldier.

rows.en: Tell me one last thing, Koji Kabuto. Where is this Robot Museum?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Sh-Shizuoka District, Atami...
rows.notes: Place-list answer is a deliberate fragment; no invented movement verb. Atami centrally verified by root against official JNTO.

rows.en: Heh heh heh, I see. So that's where these invincible robots are...
rows.notes: Museum referent settled; restored existential verb in a trailing revelation.

rows.en: In that case, Koji Kabuto... I shall have you do some work for me, too.
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: To defeat Grendizer and Duke Fleed...!
rows.notes: Purpose clause continues127 across row boundary; retained deliberate fragment.

rows.en: Eris, have we still not heard from Koji?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: N-no... I also contacted the Earth Federation Army's radar sites, but they say there's no sign of the TFO...
rows.notes: Eris answers that no contact has arrived; explicit Army glossary form retained.

rows.en: Do you think something really has happened to him?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Knowing Koji, he's probably taken a detour somewhere, hasn't he?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: A detour? Where would he go?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: How should I know?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Yeah, I guess you're right.
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Maybe you'd know? You two are buddies who tried to peek into the baths together, aren't you?
rows.notes: Asuka addresses Kaine; their joint bath-peeping attempt is a callback, not a successful peek.

rows.en: Oh, c-crap... Word about that has gotten around.
rows.notes: Actual kind is thought; Kaine realizes the story spread.

rows.en: Oh, let me tell you one thing... If you peek while I'm taking a bath...
rows.notes: Conditional threat deliberately cuts at this row boundary; result is139.

rows.en: Your nosebleed will shoot about four meters into the air, you know?
rows.notes: Four-meter nosebleed preserves exaggerated threat and the ensuing ambiguity.

rows.en: Would that be from seeing her, or from getting punched? Which is it?
rows.notes: Actual kind is thought; both arousal and being punched remain possible.

rows.en: So, where might Koji stop on a detour?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Hmm... Atami... Hot springs... Maybe he's at the sex...
rows.notes: Kaine speculates where Koji stopped; restored Koji subject/action. Kept venue word interrupted. Adult-museum allusion inferred from exchange and centrally sourced Atami Hihokan context.
uncertain: Adult-museum allusion inferred: source only begins its secret-word prefix. English sex... is a contextual adaptation, not a literal lexical match; no venue name completed. Root verified Atami Hihokan adult-museum context with official operator.

rows.en: Even for him, isn't that a bit much?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Well, well, Misato... You knew just what I meant.
rows.notes: Kaine observes that Misato recognizes his insinuation.

rows.en: What's this 'sex...' thing?
rows.notes: Ginga repeats the identical interrupted word from142; venue remains unnamed.
uncertain: Adult-museum allusion inferred: source only begins its secret-word prefix. English sex... is a contextual adaptation, not a literal lexical match; no venue name completed. Root verified Atami Hihokan adult-museum context with official operator.

rows.en: I-I don't know?
rows.notes: Hokuto is hesitant; restored first-person response rather than omission.

rows.en: You kids don't need to know. Anyway, about Koji... Given where he's headed, I've got a bad feeling.
rows.notes: Misato addresses the children then returns to Koji; destination causes her unease.

rows.en: Yes... Maybe we should send out a search party.
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Then I'll go. Captain, may I?
rows.notes: Daisuke volunteers and asks Bright for permission, not for Bright to go.

rows.en: Yes. Contact us right away if anything happens.
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Understood.
rows.notes: Daisuke to Genzo; formal assent. Decision: Restore settled subject/action; keep spoken tone and source row boundary. Retained source fragment/continuation: Understood is conventional full acknowledgement.

rows.en: That's the Robot Museum...
rows.notes: Route event11 begins here; retain Duke label after Daisuke label in preceding ship scene.

rows.en: So Mazinger Z and Great Mazinger are in there.
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: But it looks like Koji hasn't arrived yet. Where on earth could he be...?
rows.notes: Restored Koji subject in the unfinished whereabouts question.

rows.en: What!? The Vegan Empire forces!?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Mwahahaha! Duke Fleed, how convenient that you've come alone!
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Barendos! Why are you in Great Mazinger!?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... I got him to tell me where this museum was.
rows.notes: Him is Koji, as settled by interrogation and the next reveal.

rows.en: What!? D-don't tell me...!?
rows.notes: Duke begins an alarmed inference; deliberate interruption retained.

rows.en: M-Mazinger Z! And Koji! They captured you!?
rows.notes: Duke addresses captured Koji directly after spotting him with Mazinger Z.

rows.en: That's right. Now, Duke Fleed... If you value Koji Kabuto's life, hand over Grendizer!
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: What did you say!?
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Koji Kabuto is entirely under my control now... With a single command, I can make him do anything.
rows.notes: Single-command absolute control claim concerns Koji, not Grendizer.

rows.en: If you want to save your friend's life, get out of Grendizer this instant.
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Damn you and your cowardly tricks!!
rows.notes: Speaker/listener and referents settled from original route neighbors.

rows.en: Say whatever you like. Depending on how you behave...
rows.notes: Threat is deliberately left incomplete and illustrated by intervening Koji reaction.
Pure shock punctuation retained.

rows.en: K-Koji!!
rows.notes: K-Koji maps the Japanese name stutter to the English short name.

rows.en: He will suffer just like that. Now... What will you do, Duke Fleed?
rows.notes: Koji suffers from the command; Barendos resumes his question to Duke after the reaction.

rows.en: Ghh...!
...If I give them Grendizer... this green planet will suffer the same fate as Planet Fleed...!
rows.notes: Duke chooses Earth over surrendering Grendizer; this green planet is Earth.

rows.en: Forgive me, Koji...! I... I...!!
rows.notes: Deliberate repeated I trails off before stating his choice.

rows.en: Fwahahahaha! So you made the choice I expected!
Of course you would... You're the man who left your fellow people on Planet Fleed to die and fled to Earth...!
rows.notes: Barendos accuses Duke of abandoning the people of Fleed; accusation is retained as speech, not asserted narrative.

rows.en: Yes! You're the man who abandoned even your only sister!

rows.notes: Wordless shock at both uses, s0230:338 and :347.

rows.en: That's how you live your life, Duke Fleed!
And now Koji Kabuto is about to become another of your victims! You're willing to accept that!?
Ghh... ugh...! Grendizer...!
rows.notes: Duke starts a statement about Grendizer; Barendos interrupts with row178.

rows.en: Grendizer... what?
rows.notes: Explicit Grendizer topic retained; deliberately incomplete source question echoed.

rows.en: I won't hand my Grendizer... over to devils like you...!
Admirable resolve, even in an enemy. But you must pay for everything you've done.
Pay for it...!?
rows.notes: Echo question refers to Barendos saying Duke must pay in180.

rows.en: That's right. Die here at the hands of the friend you abandoned!
Now, Koji Kabuto... defeat Duke Fleed. With that invincible demon of yours, fwahaha!
rows.notes: Demon renders majin literally in Barendos mockery; later god/devil exchange confirms wordplay.
uncertain: Literal demon for majin preserves the later god/devil wordplay; English cannot reproduce the Mazinger/majin sound association.

rows.en: ...Understood... I'll... defeat Duke Fleed...
rows.notes: Restored I for Koji obeying the command to defeat Duke.

rows.en: K-Koji...!!
Let me tell you one thing, Duke Fleed. If you lose your senses and try to defeat me...
rows.notes: Conditional threat deliberately continues into187.

rows.en: You can expect Koji Kabuto to die on the spot.
rows.notes: Completes186 threat: Barendos will kill Koji if Duke attacks him.

rows.en: Damn it...! But there must be a chance...! There has to be!
1. Cut Mazinger Z HP to 60% or less; persuade Koji
rows.notes: Win objective repeated unchanged at354 and359; persuade is the game action. Measured draft overflow 449px; cut replaces reduce and Koji abbreviates Koji Kabuto. Both threshold and persuade action retained; final 329px.

rows.en: 1. Grendizer is shot down@2. Great Mazinger takes damage@3. Mazinger Z is shot down
rows.notes: Loss conditions repeated unchanged at355 and360; preserve all three segments.

rows.en: ...I'll... defeat Duke Fleed...
rows.notes: Restored I for brainwashed Koji obeying183.

rows.en: There must be a chance for me to save Koji...!
If I can just exploit an opening in Mazinger and break the mind control!
rows.notes: Deliberate conditional exclamation; restored I and both exploit-opening and break-control actions.

rows.en: Hm!? What is that wretch doing!?
rows.notes: That wretch refers to Duke attempting to persuade Koji.

rows.en: Koji! Koji, pull yourself together!
Barendos is controlling you! Come to your senses, Koji!
...U-ugh... ugh...
Damn it, is it no use!?
rows.notes: Is it no use refers to Duke failing to bring Koji back to his senses.

rows.en: You fool! The mind-control transmitter is here with me! Until you destroy it, Koji Kabuto will never come to his senses!
rows.notes: Transmitter is with Barendos, not in Koji; its destruction is the stated condition for recovery.

rows.en: Heh... hehehehe.
What's so funny!?
I owe you my thanks, Barendos! You've told me how to save Koji!
rows.notes: Duke thanks the enemy for inadvertently revealing the rescue method.

rows.en: Tch, damn it...! But can you defeat this Great Mazinger!?
Great Mazinger... the great hero that defeated Mycenae...! It's certainly a formidable foe...!
rows.notes: Mycenae uses glossary Mycenae Empire stem without adding Empire absent source.

rows.en: Hehehe, I'll snuff out your life with my own hands!
Great Mazinger will be a valuable asset to our forces... So I can't destroy it...!
rows.notes: Our forces refers to Duke and allies; retain value of captured Great Mazinger and decision not to destroy it.

rows.en: I have to find some way to stop it from moving!
rows.notes: It is Great Mazinger; Duke seeks immobilization without destruction.

rows.en: ...Th-the wings'...
rows.notes: Deliberate incomplete stammer;209 supplies wing storage compartment.
Bare surprise/interrogation symbols retained.

rows.en: ...The wings'... storage compartment...
rows.notes: Deliberate fragment answering207; does not invent an attack or mechanism.

rows.en: Koji!?
...If you damage Great there... for just a moment... all its functions will...
rows.notes: Koji is interrupted before the predicate for all functions; retain incomplete ending rather than add shutdown.

rows.en: You had to open your mouth! Has the mind control worn off!?
rows.notes: Barendos reacts to Koji divulging the weak point.

rows.en: Koji...! Hang on. I'll save you right away!
1. Reduce Great Mazinger's HP to 30% or less
rows.notes: New win objective after weak-point revelation.

rows.en: 1. Grendizer is shot down@2. Mazinger Z is shot down@3. Great Mazinger is shot down
rows.notes: New loss conditions allow damage to Great but prohibit shooting it down.

rows.en: Damn it, my back!!
rows.notes: Interrupted cry as Duke attacks the rear weak point.

rows.en: Now! Koji, come to your senses!!
Ugh... uuugh...!
I told you, Duke Fleed! It's impossible unless you destroy the device!
rows.notes: It refers to restoring Koji to his senses, as explained in199.

rows.en: Pull yourself together, Koji! You should be able to fight off his mind control!
You fought Dr. Hell in Mazinger Z and won with your own hands! You can do it!
rows.notes: Restored you can do it for source conditional encouragement; predicate supplied by220 and ongoing appeal to Koji.

rows.en: ...Ghh... uuugh...!
Or are you going to turn that Mazinger Z into a messenger of evil!?
Are you going to turn the Mazinger that's fought beside you into a real demon god!?
U... Ugh!
Uoooooh!!
W-what!?
Koji...!
...Sorry, Duke Fleed. I almost forgot something really important...!
rows.notes: Koji apologizes to Duke after breaking the mind control; next row specifies what he nearly forgot.

rows.en: That Mazinger Z isn't a messenger of evil... It's a messenger of peace...!
rows.notes: Continues the content of the important thing in row230.

rows.en: You fool! Weren't you the one who said that machine could make you a god or a devil!?
Shut up! I don't want to be a god or a devil!
What!?
I'm Koji Kabuto! Being the pilot of Mazinger Z, the defender of peace, is enough for me!!
Y-you bastard...!
Koji!
Yeah! I'll teach that bastard how to use a Mazinger!!
rows.notes: That bastard is Barendos; explicit subject and instructional direction retained.

rows.en: And we'll get Tetsuya's Great back!!
rows.notes: Great is the source short form for Tetsuya's Great Mazinger.

rows.en: With this...!
rows.notes: Deliberately unfinished demonstrative during the attack; action not invented.

rows.en: How do you like that, Barendos!!
G-grr! Then I'll have to escape!!
Heh! The bastard ditched the Great and ran!
rows.notes: Koji initially mistakes Barendos's escape for retreat; Duke corrects him next.

rows.en: No, that's not what happened!
What!?
Then I'll bury Grendizer along with Mazinger Z!
Tch! He's sending out Saucer Beasts in droves!
rows.notes: Barendos deploys many Saucer Beasts; explicit agent restored.

rows.en: The Nahel Argama! You've come to help!
All units, launch immediately! Cover Grendizer and Mazinger Z!
All right, begin the attack!
1. Allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Player; defeat objective; allied carrier condition. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: The enemy signals have disappeared.
rows.notes: Collective enemy signals disappear after the annihilation objective, reported to Bright.

rows.en: That was a close call...
Yes. If things had gone wrong, the Vegan Empire could have stolen Mazinger.
rows.notes: Douglas answers Bright about the close call. Mazinger is the unexpanded source short reference.
uncertain: The source does not specify Z versus Great here; retain Mazinger without choosing a specific unit or explicit plural.

rows.en: Ta-da! Sorry to keep you waiting, everyone! Borot has arrived!
rows.notes: Borot is the source short form of Boss Borot; spoken entrance fanfare.

rows.en: Boss! And Sayaka, too!
rows.notes: Deliberate names-only greeting.

rows.en: Koji, it looks like you made it into Mazinger Z safely.
Heh heh! Well, a lot happened along the way.
Mazinger Z really does suit you, Koji.
Hey, the TFO suits me too!
rows.notes: Koji says the TFO suits him too, answering Sayaka rather than praising the TFO generally.

rows.en: Kabuto! Where's the enemy? Where!?
rows.notes: Boss uses Koji's surname; repetition retained.

rows.en: Boss, it looks like the battle's already over.
Looks like we were late getting here this time.
Aw, man... And we hurried all the way here, too.
Come on, Boss. Just knowing you wanted to help means a lot to me.
Thanks for coming, everyone.
I'm glad to see you're doing well too, Koji.
Heh! Now that we're here, you can relax like you're aboard a big, sturdy ship.
rows.notes: Retains the big safe ship image so Mucha's mud-boat rebuttal still works.

rows.en: Maybe you mean a boat made of mud.
rows.notes: Mud/clay boat is an unsafe counterimage to the large ship. Ignore stray source closing wrapper and @ tail, as brief directs.

rows.en: I feel like we had this same conversation about a year ago.
rows.notes: Nuke recalls an earlier conversation; no invented specification of which prior game/event.

rows.en: What? Is this another Three Idiots Trio?
rows.notes: Glossary Three Idiots Trio nickname applied to the newly arrived Boss/Nuke/Mucha trio.

rows.en: Come to think of it, we've got a lot of trios this time.
A lot...? It's just you guys and the Getter team, isn't it?
rows.notes: Asuka addresses Kaine; Getter team preserved.

rows.en: You and your friends count too, Asuka, don't you?
rows.notes: Akira includes Asuka and the EVA pilots in the count.

rows.en: Why do we count?
Well, look. Zero, One, Two. That makes three of you.
rows.notes: Zero/One/Two are EVA unit numbers; three pilots remain explicit.

rows.en: Yeah, exactly.
D-don't lump me in with that idiot Shinji and the First!
rows.notes: First is Asuka's shortened First Child label for Rei; source insult and stutter retained.

rows.en: ...By the way, is there a guy named Daisuke Umon here?
rows.notes: Boss asks for Duke under his Daisuke Umon alias, preserved rather than normalized to Duke.

rows.en: That's me, but...
rows.notes: Daisuke identifies himself; source trailing hesitation retained.

rows.en: Hey! You lucky devil, you ladies' man!
rows.notes: Boss affectionately teases Daisuke about Hikaru; not literal hostility.

rows.en: A ladies' man?
rows.notes: Repeats the epithet as an incredulous question; deliberate fragment.

rows.en: ...Come on in, Hikaru.
Hikaru...! What are you doing on the Nahel Argama...?!
rows.notes: Restored Daisuke asking why Hikaru is aboard the ship.

rows.en: Starting today, I'll be fighting alongside you all, Daisuke.
What...?! No! Go back to the laboratory at once!
No. I...made up my mind during Operation Yashima. I wanted to help you all, Daisuke...
rows.notes: Hikaru asks to help Daisuke and his companions; her resolve dates to Operation Yashima.

rows.en: Hikaru's amazing. She went through tough training at the Photon Power Laboratory, and now she's a fully qualified pilot.
W-when did all that happen...?
rows.notes: Restored question verb; surprise at previously unknown training.

rows.en: But, Hikaru... Having a woman like you fight...
rows.notes: Preserved unfinished objection and explicitly sexist premise.

rows.en: How old-fashioned~. Then what does that make us?
But she wasn't destined to fight. There's no need for her to deliberately put herself in danger...
rows.notes: Preserved unfinished danger objection.

rows.en: ...When someone chooses to fight, being a man or a woman makes no difference.
rows.notes: Domon addresses Daisuke; gender does not distinguish willing fighters.

rows.en: If you're worried about her, why don't you protect her yourself?
Please, Daisuke. Let me help, too.
rows.notes: Request runs from Hikaru to Daisuke, asking permission to help.

rows.en: ...All right. I'll accept your help, Hikaru.
rows.notes: Daisuke accepts Hikaru's help.

rows.en: Heh heh, that settles that.
You've got some nerve saying that when you're the one who started all this trouble.
rows.notes: Asuka addresses Koji, holding him responsible for the preceding incident.

rows.en: I'll work hard in Mazinger Z and make up for it.
Then let's see what the original Super Robot can do.
Oh, right... Koji. Shiro gave me something to bring you.
Huh? From Shiro?
Here you go. The pilot suit and helmet you used to wear.
rows.notes: Suit and helmet belong to Koji, not Shiro.

rows.en: This takes me back... They're full of memories of all the battles I fought alongside Mazinger.
Shiro polished them until they gleamed every single day, you know?
What will you do, Koji? Which will you wear...your current suit or your old one?
Let's see...
@"Mazinger Z pilot suit"@"TFO pilot suit"
rows.notes: Choice UI: empty first segment and exactly two @ separators preserved; quotation marks are visible choice labels.

rows.en: Then I'll take the Mazinger Z suit. I've worn it for years, so I'm attached to it.
rows.notes: First choice branch: Koji selects his old Mazinger Z suit.

rows.en: I'll stick with my current one. I want to keep those memories safe.
rows.notes: Second choice branch: current TFO suit; protects old memories rather than rejecting them.

rows.en: All right.
Well, I'm counting on you all from here on out, everyone.
rows.notes: Koji requests continued support from the group; request direction preserved.

rows.en: I see. So both Mazinger Z and Great came through safely?
Yes, thanks to your son Koji and Daisuke Umon.
rows.notes: Restored predicate in response to Kenzo about safe recovery.

rows.en: I understand. Thank you for taking the trouble to let me know.
By the way...how is that machine Genzo Umon asked you to build coming along?
rows.notes: Restored progress-question verb; fixed glossary spelling Genzo Umon.

rows.en: The new Spazer, you mean. We're currently installing its outer armor at our laboratory.
Once that's finished, we plan to send it back to the Institute of Space Science.
An Earth-built Spazer created by you, Genzo Umon and me... I can hardly wait for it to be finished.
rows.notes: All three researchers retained; Genzo Umon spelling follows protected glossary.

rows.en: Yes. Once we can deploy it in battle, it should help Koji, Daisuke and the others.
rows.notes: Stray trailing source close-quote/@ ignored per brief.

rows.en: Well, until next time...
Director...
rows.notes: Hidden source speaker remains ??? despite next line establishing identity.

rows.en: Tetsuya, should you really be out of bed?
Please let me go. I can't leave Koji, Ryo and the others to do all the fighting.
rows.notes: Source nickname Ryo centrally confirmed from SRW Wiki; same Ryoma Nagare identity, not the separate Apocrypha character. Tetsuya requests Kenzo permit deployment.

rows.en: No.
Director!
We plan to correct Great's weaknesses and install a new weapon at the same time.
rows.notes: New weapon treated as singular, settled by Jun's reaction at330.

rows.en: And to master it, you must be in perfect physical condition yourself.
rows.notes: New weapon treated as singular, settled by Jun's reaction at330.

rows.en: My physical condition...?
rows.notes: Deliberate echo question fragment.

rows.en: That's right. In your current condition, the shock of using it could make you pass out.
rows.notes: New weapon treated as singular, settled by Jun's reaction at330.

rows.en: To think even Tetsuya, with all his rigorous training, would struggle to master a weapon like that...
rows.notes: Jun's trailing astonishment preserved as an unfinished sentence.
Deliberate silence retained.

rows.en: Tetsuya, I understand you're eager to return...but your mission right now is to focus on rehabilitation.
That's right, Tetsuya. You'll definitely make a comeback...and that day isn't far off.
...All right. But, Director...please hurry with Great's upgrades, will you?
rows.notes: Tetsuya requests Kenzo hurry repairs.

rows.en: Yes. You can count on me.
rows.notes: Kenzo offers assurance to Tetsuya; direction differs from Koji's request at311.

rows.en: Wait for me, Koji, Ryo... I'll definitely make a comeback and fight alongside you...!
rows.notes: Source nickname Ryo centrally confirmed from SRW Wiki; same Ryoma Nagare identity, not the separate Apocrypha character. Thought kind; Tetsuya silently addresses Koji and Ryo.

context_review.note: Reviewed all 152 reused rows:143 generic defeat rows match Stage9 exactly;9 other original numeric-use neighborhoods retain reactions, silence and mission conditions without new referents. Reviewed four fresh uncertainties against neighbors: interrupted Atami adult-museum allusion, majin wordplay and unspecified Mazinger. All 337 final rows fit; one measured objective overflow189 shortened while retaining HP60% inclusive threshold and persuasion order. Ryo nickname confirmed and initial drafts retained.
